Package
Description
org.apache.juneau.http.resource
Next-generation HTTP resource types — bodies bundled with associated headers.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.rest
Petstore REST resources.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console
Engine-agnostic themeable admin-console chrome: Theme, the stock theme stylesheets, the bundled chrome.css asset, and ConsoleChromeMixin.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.convention
Convention-endpoints mixin pack — composable @Rest(mixins=...) resources that ship the "internet conventions" surface (favicon, robots, sitemap, version, well-known) every public-facing service eventually grows.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.datatables
The DataTables server-side-processing JSON beans implementing the DataTables server-side processing wire contract.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.ops
Ops / introspection mixin pack — composable @Rest(mixins=...) resources that ship the operational surface (request echo, JVM admin, route index) every long-running Juneau service eventually grows.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.staticfile
REST Static Files Support
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal
Raw command output in the browser: a byte-offset endpoint over a TerminalSource and an xterm.js panel that renders it the way a terminal would.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.util
REST Server Utilities
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views
A typed, declarative "rich DataTables view" toolkit that serializes to the frozen VIEW_META JSON wire contract consumed by the first-party client runtime.
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets
Reusable widget primitives for the Juneau REST server toolkit.
